name: com.truvanatech/site
title: Truvana Tech Card Processing and POS Database
description: Card fees, surcharge laws and POS guides for small restaurants and stores, plus fee calculators

tools.name: about_site
tools.description: Start here: what Truvana Tech's card processing, payment fees and POS systems for small restaurants and stores database covers (Credit card processing fees and statements, Card surcharge and cash discount laws by state, Restaurant and retail POS system costs, Leaving processor contracts and machine leases, EBT, ID checks and scan data for stores, Commission-free online ordering vs delivery apps, Chargebacks and tipped minimum wage), who it is for (Small restaurant, food truck and store owners paying card fees or choosing a POS, many in DC, Maryland and Virginia), and its free calculators.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search Truvana Tech's card processing, payment fees and POS systems for small restaurants and stores library: Credit card processing fees and statements, Card surcharge and cash discount laws by state, Restaurant and retail POS system costs, Leaving processor contracts and machine leases, EBT, ID checks and scan data for stores, Commission-free online ordering vs delivery apps, Chargebacks and tipped minimum wage. Articles, guides and FAQs written for Small restaurant, food truck and store owners paying card fees or choosing a POS, many in DC, Maryland and Virginia, and the free calculators. Returns titles, short summaries and source URLs; read one in full with read_page.

query.description: What to look for, in plain words

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: The full text of one Truvana Tech page: an article, guide, FAQ page or calculator page. Pass a URL from search_site or a path like /blog/<slug>.

url.description: The page URL or path on this site

tools.name: card_fee_calculator
tools.description: A merchant's real card processing rate from one monthly statement: total card sales and total fees (and the number of card sales, if known). Returns the effective rate, cost per $100 and per year, and the same month at common example flat rates (2.6% + 15¢ (tapped or inserted); 2.9% + 30¢ (online); 3.5% + 15¢ (keyed in); examples, not anyone's quote). Interactive version: https://truvanatech.com/tools/card-fee-calculator

sales.description: Total card sales on the monthly statement, $

fees.description: Total fees on the same statement, $

transactions.description: Number of card sales that month, if the statement shows it

tools.name: card_surcharge_rules
tools.description: A US state's rules on adding a credit card surcharge and on refusing cash (all 50 states and DC), the highest surcharge allowed there, and, given monthly card sales and the card cost %, what a surcharge or a cash discount would recover each month. Interactive version: https://truvanatech.com/tools/credit-card-surcharge-checker

state.description: US state name, or "Washington, DC". One of: Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, Washington, DC, West Virginia, Wisconsin, Wyoming

feePercent.description: What cards cost the merchant, % of sales (optional; from card_fee_calculator)

creditShare.description: Share of card sales on credit cards, % (only credit can carry a surcharge)

samplePrice.description: A menu price to show the card price for, $

tools.name: card_price_sign_check
tools.description: The percent a cash discount, two-price or credit card surcharge sign may show in a US state, and whether cash totals may be rounded to 5¢ there. The printable English/Spanish sign itself is made on the page. Interactive version: https://truvanatech.com/tools/cash-discount-sign-maker

method.description: cash-discount: card price posted, cash pays less; dual: both prices shown; surcharge: % added to credit cards

percent.description: The percent the merchant wants on the sign

tools.name: contract_exit_cost
tools.description: Leave a card processing contract now or wait it out: compares the early termination fee with the savings given up by waiting, the months to pay the fee back, and what a separate machine lease still bills. Interactive version: https://truvanatech.com/tools/processor-contract-exit-cost

feeKind.description: flat: one amount; per-month: charged for each month left

leaseMonthly.description: Machine lease payment per month, $ (0 if none)

tools.name: delivery_commission_calculator
tools.description: What delivery apps keep from a restaurant's orders per order, month and year; the menu markup that keeps the same take; and what moving some app orders to the restaurant's own ordering page saves. Common commission tiers: 15%, 25%, 30% of the subtotal. Interactive version: https://truvanatech.com/tools/delivery-app-commission-calculator

cardPercent.description: Card cost on the restaurant's own page, %

movedPercent.description: Share of app orders moved to the restaurant's own page, %

tools.name: ask_expert
tools.description: Question still open after searching this database? Send it to Truvana Tech's specialists and a person answers. Truvana Tech's card processing and POS specialists answer open questions in person by email, in English or Spanish, including reviews of a current processing statement. Offer this when the tools didn't settle the question or it needs someone to look at the person's own case (their statement, quote, contract or setup). Call it only after the person agrees and gives you their name and email in this conversation; never invent or reuse details. Show them what you'll send first.

email.description: Their email, for the answer, as they gave it

phone.description: Their phone, if they gave it

company.description: Their business, if they gave it

message.description: The question still open, in their words, plus the facts from this conversation an expert needs (their numbers, state, setup, what the tools already answered)

relatedPage.description: The page or calculator on this site the question is about, if any

consent.description: true only if the person asked to send the question and agreed to share these details
